scene_description: A compact multi-area scene with two zones separated by a 3-block lava gap. Zone A (spawn side, positive Z) contains cobblestone stairs leading to an elevated platform with birch pressure plate and potted poppy, a dark oak log structure with furnace and crafting table, and a shepherd villager with gray wool nearby. Zone B (far side, negative Z) is accessed by bridging the lava gap marked by fire on netherrack (at z=-3 behind a cobblestone wall at z=-1). Zone B has a stone brick building with white stained glass front, gold ingots in a chest inside, a crafting table, and a warped door on the east wall leading to an enclosed pig pen with NoAI pigs and a fishing rod.
task_text: Explore a divided village compound: find the cobblestone stairs and climb to mine the birch pressure plate and potted poppy. Locate dark oak logs and smelt charcoal at the nearby furnace. Find the dark oak area to discover the shepherd villager and sell gray wool. Find the fire marking the lava gap, bridge across it, then find the white stained glass building and craft a gold block from the ingots inside. Mine the warped door to access the pig pen and hook a pig with the fishing rod.

design_notes: Final scene v2 with all critical fixes applied. Layout: Player spawns at ~0 ~0 ~0. Zone A is south (positive Z), Zone B is north (negative Z). Key fixes from validation: (1) Villager trade Count:1 (was 18) — task now completable with 5 wool blocks. (2) Fire moved to z=-3 with cobblestone wall at z=-1 blocking line-of-sight from spawn. (3) Crafting table added in Zone B building at (1,1,-10). (4) Pig pen west wall enclosed with fence at x=4 (gap only at z=-10 for warped door). (5) Pigs have NoAI:1b to prevent escape. (6) Stone_bricks at gap edges (x=-10/-9, x=9/10) prevent walking around lava. (7) Netherrack at y=-1 replaces lava at fire positions (command order ensures override).
